title: Void Surplus/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue spoken by Baro Ki'Teer when opening the Void Surplus:
- Baro Ki' Teer: "They say fortune favors the bold. Feeling lucky today, Tenno?"
DBaroLootbox0010Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "I simply don't have time to sort through all of this. You're doing me a favor, Tenno."
DBaroLootbox0020Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Even I have no idea what's inside."
DBaroLootbox0030Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "That was in there? Goodness me."
DBaroLootbox0040Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "The thrill of a good find... It's incomparable."
DBaroLootbox0050Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Do peruse my regular wares too, won't you?"
DBaroLootbox0060Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Oh, and no refunds."
DBaroLootbox0070Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Still better than a Darvo deal."
DBaroLootbox0080Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Sometimes my daring relic-seekers bring back such folderol. And sometimes they uncover priceless treasures. It's why I keep them around."
DBaroLootbox0090Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "It's never been easier to be a customer!"
DBaroLootbox0100Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "You know, Tenno, it pains me to part with anything for such a meager price. But needs must."
DBaroLootbox0110Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Maybe you'll find an invitation to one of my parties! No, of course you won't."
DBaroLootbox0120Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Baro, I hear you ask, how are you so successful you can give away all this for next to nothing? First, you have to be as suave and cunning as me."
DBaroLootbox0130Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "I wouldn't have become the most successful Void Trader in the Origin System without relishing the call of uncertainty."
DBaroLootbox0140Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Opening this box is a lot like an expedition to the Void. You never know what to expect."
DBaroLootbox0150Baro_en.ogg
- Baro Ki' Teer: "Well, well. It seems my loss is your gain."
DBaroLootbox0160Baro_en.ogg
